name: Warehouse 40x20 — two docks
note: Formula: pixelX = (worldX + transX) * scale, pixelY = (-worldY + transY) * scale. scaleFactor and transX are taken verbatim from Yuxing's VSS calibration.json; transY is converted from the VSS value 39.43329917942558 because VSS measures pixelY from the image bottom: transY = imageHeight / scaleFactor - transY_vss = 1080 / 26.829178663553755 - 39.43329917942558. defaultForkliftStart is forklift_b's spawn: block in robots-40x20.yaml; for forklift_b2 use world_y -21.63.
